Local Browser Reports 47 Open Tabs, “Totally Under Control”

By A. Reporter · 6 min read
Illustration: a very full tab bar

Sources close to the browser confirm that at least a dozen of the tabs have not been looked at since spring. “I’ll get to them,” said the owner, opening another one.

Experts warn that the number of open tabs tends to grow until it reaches equilibrium with the amount of free memory, at which point the laptop fan begins to sing.

Meanwhile, a small purple creature has reportedly been seen in the corner of several screens. It could not be reached for comment, although it did say “I am not paid enough for this.”
